data.narrative:
PAVE Space is a seed-stage space & aerospace company founded by Julie Böhning and Jérémy Marciacq, both with prior experience co-founding the Gruyère Space Program at EPFL. The company has raised $40M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method yielded reliable output. Applying a standard 2.5x seed-to-next-stage multiplier to the $40M total raised proxy implies a valuation of $100M. The peer-median approach cannot be applied: while 14 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier companies yielded fewer than three datapoints—insufficient for robust analysis. Public-comp anchoring via the sector's 27.4x median price-to-sales multiple is likewise inapplicable, as PAVE Space's revenue has not been disclosed.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $85M to $115M, centered at $100M. This range reflects stage-typical step-up dynamics but carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method. Critical unknowns include the company's current revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and technical differentiation versus the private peer set—any of which could materially shift the valuation if disclosed.
